meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: Claude 会去搜索你在 cmem.ai 上的 Claude-Mem 持久记忆(含过往各 agent 会话合成的带时间戳观察记录):先用宽泛关键词粗搜,再用精确词缩小范围,最后用通俗语言综合出答案,你问「什么时候」时会引用时间戳。
howto.when: 当你提到「搜索记忆」「claude-mem」等关键词,或想了解某个项目、决策、文件、任务的过往会话背景时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索记忆里关于这个项目部署的记录
say.note: 先宽泛粗搜,再按更精确的词缩小范围

say.text: 上次会话我们做了什么?
say.note: 返回带时间戳的观察记录,而非原始输出

say.text: 检查一下 claude-mem 状态
say.note: 运行 status,查看 API key 是否缺失等情况

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude searches your Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai (observations from past sessions across your agents). It does broad keyword passes first, then narrows, and answers in plain language, quoting timestamps when you ask when.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "search memory" or "check claude-mem", or want prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches your cmem.ai memory.

say_en.text: Search memory for what we did on this project's deploy
What did we do last session?

say_en.note: Runs status to show API key state
